capabilities: Embed a search field in any note via an embedded-omnisearch code block
Restrict searches by path, file type, and exclusions at the code-block level
Paginate results with relevance scores, excerpts, and highlighted matches
Configure default page size, highlight color, and highlight opacity in settings
Open clicked results in preview mode and show file paths on Alt-hover
extras: Discloses no telemetry, no network requests, and no access outside the vault; includes a troubleshooting section for missing search UI, Omnisearch API errors, and indexing gaps.
intentEvidence: It is powered by the Omnisearch API
problem: Obsidian's search lives in a separate panel, so there is no way to place a live, filtered search view directly inside a note.
summary: Embedded search UI that renders an inline Omnisearch-powered search field inside notes via a fenced code block, with filters, pagination, and configurable highlights.
